hypothesis: The shared blocks state MLP and two relation objectives can learn routing on a fixed graph without a learned V table.
graph_suite: Generated by generalization_path_map in the explicit output directory
selection: Best validation Huber plus full candidate soft rank CE; fixed step budget. Test is evaluated only before and after training, never for selection.
split: Seen nodes, unseen unordered relations. Withhold each validation/test parent-to-goal and every candidate-to-goal relation in both directions from BOTH losses. Preserve all physical edge labels. Rollouts can later enter trained relations; this is not unseen-graph or unseen-trajectory generalization.
scope: Same two-hidden-layer state MLP and mean Huber plus soft-distance ranking as blocks/Hanoi/cube. Node ID one-hot is the task input. Primary routing allows all legal neighbors, including return moves; detect deterministic cycles. No learned V, coordinates, search or LLM retraining. Task metrics remain explicit rather than claiming identical directed and reversible geometries.
